title: A round is a segment
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine, $a$ a state, $E$ a set of optional states, and $P$ a property of work-head positions. If $c$ and $c'$ form a round of duration $t$ and $\mathrm{some}(a)\notin E$, then the run from $c$ to $c'$ is a segment of duration $t$: before the endpoint its state avoids $E$, and through the endpoint its work-head positions satisfy $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ is a set of optional states
$P$ is a property of work-head positions
